name: Baron Marinous
summary: Onu seeks to learn what happened to a water globe left by an elemental guardian. You bring it to him at the Grove of the Ancients, where he recognizes a troubling sign.

sections.title: Onu's Counsel
sections.body: Onu at the Grove of the Ancients needs the Clouded Water Globe. The elemental guardian is defeated, but the globe remains clouded and whatever happened to the guardian and the ruins it guarded may still be active. You bring it to Onu, the one most likely to know more.

sections.title: Onu's Concern
sections.body: At the Grove of the Ancients, Onu reacts with surprise to the globe and wonders whether there are stairs descending in Mathystra. He says he must confer with the others. He is glad you uncovered this before the naga or their cult allies, and notes that defeating the elemental guardian was no small feat.

faq.answer: Onu is the Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.

faq.q: What is the Clouded Water Globe?
faq.answer: It is all that remains of a powerful elemental, a globe of water clouded by an unknown substance.

faq.q: Why does the globe look clouded?
faq.answer: An unknown substance clouds the globe and seems to prevent anyone from seeing inside.

faq.q: Where do I take the globe?
faq.answer: Bring the Clouded Water Globe to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.

faq.q: What happened to the elemental guardian?
faq.answer: The elemental guardian has been defeated, and the globe is all that remains of it.

faq.q: What does Onu say about the naga?
faq.answer: Onu says it is good the globe was uncovered before the naga or their cult allies.
